name: Research Paper Seminar
description: Presents a study the way a seminar expects: background, research question, method, the main finding, how it compares to earlier work, limitations, and what's next.
audience: Undergraduate and postgraduate seminars, journal clubs, paper presentations.

signals.why: your words describe a research presentation

slides.guidance: The study or topic {topic} as the title, with a subtitle naming the course or seminar.
The research question and what the study set out to show, as 2 or 3 aims.
What was known before, and the gap this work addresses. Cite only the source material.
How the study was done, as ordered steps: data, procedure, analysis.
The main result in one sentence, with its key number if the source gives one.
How this result compares with earlier work or alternative approaches.
Limitations and open questions for the audience to discuss.
Takeaways: what we now know, how sure we are, what to study next.
